title: activated sludge metagenome Raw sequence reads
description: This project investigates temporal changes in the microbial community and functional potential of activated sludge in laboratory-scale anoxic-aerobic sequencing batch reactors (SBRs). The reactors were inoculated with activated sludge collected from a textile dyeing wastewater treatment plant in Dongguan, China, and operated as a non-bioaugmented control (CK) and an NPD-1-bioaugmented treatment (BA). Metagenomic sequencing was performed on activated sludge samples collected at selected operational time points to evaluate microbial community dynamics and functional responses associated with NPD-1 bioaugmentation.
